descriptions.interaction: Connect a local/remote database with read access; inspect schema; generate/drag canned patterns; edit nodes,edges,labels/properties; inspect live Cypher translation; execute and navigate matching result records
descriptions.guidance: Metadata/schema constraints,top-k edge-diversified TED patterns and real-time Cypher translation; additional node inequalities enforce node-isomorphic matches
descriptions.visualisation: Graph editor and pattern palette,schema/metadata views,translated Cypher panel,force-directed result graph and matching-record list
